judgement.when: Possessed Lord (once per battle, start of the Fight phase)
judgement.note: and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] until the end of the phase

source.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model and those weapons have the **[Devastating Wounds]** ability.

judgement.when: Picked by a Knight Defender (Bondsman, your Command phase)
judgement.note: -1 Damage to each attack allocated to that ARMIGER model

source.text: While a model is affected by this ability, each time an attack is allocated to that model, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

judgement.code:
const oneOffMod = (m, u) => { const ab = ((u && u.abilities) || []).find(x => x.name === m.from);
  return /\bonce per battle\b/i.test([m.when, ab && ab.tag, ab && ab.text].join(' ')); };

source.implements: a footnote that is a one-off use the player makes (its when, its ability's tag or words say once per battle: Possessed Lord): not in the weapon's numbers (the owner's decision, 2026-10-26)
which footnote a weapon row shows in its numbers ("8 (+6)", "7/10"): one that changes that weapon's values (weapon, set), unless a one-off (oneOffMod)

judgement.code: const footMod = (m, u) => m.weapon && m.set && oneOffMod(m, u) ? Object.assign({}, m, { note:m.weapon + ' ' + Object.entries(m.set).map(([k, v]) => /^[+-]/.test(v) ? v + ' ' + k : k + ' ' + v).join(', ') + ' ' + m.note }) : m;

source.implements: a one-off's footnote under the weapons: its numbers first, with the weapon ("Lacerator and daemonic claw +3 A and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] until the end of the phase"), as the row no longer shows them
